newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soyoil up sharply in fast trade on funds.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soyoil up sharply in fast trade on funds.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures were sharply higher in fast trade, led by new crop on aggressive fund and commercial buying tied to concerns hot, dry weather would damage soybean crops, pit sources said.
Traders said Produce Grain bought 1,100 lots soyoil and Cargill Inc and ADM each bought 400 lots.

Forecasts called for hot, dry weather in the U.S. Midwest through Friday. No rain was expected until the weekend. Traders said that scenario can be harmful to developing crops and continued moisture and heat stress can cut yields.
At 1209 CDT, soyoil was up 0.50 to 0.16 cent per lb with December up 0.47 at 23.10.
